positive_claim: AM.M4.AUTOCONF_BRIDGE.1 sealed: Traces 6 macro types via autom4te oracle: AC_INIT (package/version/bug-report/tarname), AM_INIT_AUTOMAKE (strictness: foreign/gnu/gnits), AC_CONFIG_FILES (output file list), AC_CONFIG_HEADERS (header list), AM_CONDITIONAL (condition/boolean), AC_SUBST (variable list). Bracket-aware argument parser handles nested brackets and empty args. 2 unit tests + 1 integration test. Native path (extract_traces_native) typed as non-claim until autoconf-rs-core matures.
non_claims: Native trace extraction (without autom4te oracle) not yet integrated
AC_PROG_* language detection not fully implemented
Full substitution value resolution (not just key list) not implemented

known_divergences.oracle_behavior: GNU automake uses Perl M4 bridge internally
known_divergences.rust_behavior: We delegate to autom4te oracle for trace extraction
known_divergences.reason: Clean-room: we call autom4te as a subordinate oracle rather than embedding M4 parsing
